lines.text: Auger, TOPSIDE. You are cleared to descend. Keep the chatter on channel two.
Auger, this is TOPSIDE. Your manifest is approved. Do not open the sealed crates.
Copy your first bite, Auger. Mind the drill room temperature. We have lost crews to impatience.
TOPSIDE reads a fire aboard. Put it out, Auger. The paperwork for a fire is worse than the fire.
Water in the lower deck. Pumps first, questions later.
Auger, your hull telemetry is ugly. Patch what you can. We are not sending anyone.
Unregistered rig on your scope. They are not friends. They are not ours, either.
Good work. Do not salvage their logs. Send them up unread.
We copy the loss. Log it and keep moving, Auger.
Interesting find. Recalibrate and disregard.
Seismic says something large is moving behind you. Do not stop to look.
That is the gate, Auger. Nobody has come back up through it. Nobody has tried.
Auger, TOPSIDE. Weather up here is clear. You will not be needing that information.
Copy, Auger. We have your heading. We had it before you did.
Fire on your telemetry, Auger. Smother it. Do not vent smoke toward the rock.
You are taking water, Auger. Keep it out of the reactor room and we can discuss the rest.
Hull at critical. Your contract has a clause for this, Auger. You would not enjoy it.
Hostile rig. You are authorized to defend the hardware. The crew is covered under a separate line item.
Copy the kill. Their tower was never registered, so neither was this.
Loss confirmed. Their replacement is already - Disregard. Carry on with the crew you have.
TOPSIDE has logged your find, Auger. It was already in the log.
Reduce drill noise now, Auger. Do not ask us what is listening.
Gate on your scope. The last crew through reported warm air. We do not have the rest of that transmission.
That trader is not on our books, Auger. Pay in gems, not names.
Auger, TOPSIDE. You have broken into a void that is not on the survey. Note the contents. Do not note them aloud.
Copy the break-in. That construction predates your clearance, Auger. Most of what you find will.
Any sealed container in there is program property. Even the ones we did not - Disregard. Open with care.
The drill reads zero bars, Auger. Q W E R T give a system power, and Shift takes it back. Start with the drill.
Your drill has no power. Q W E R T each feed one system, Shift takes a bar away. The rock will not cut itself.
You have not touched the heading. A and D turn the drill toward the ore on your scanner. We assume you noticed the ore.
Still pointed straight down, Auger. A and D steer toward whatever the scanner likes. It is allowed to like things.
A seam runs level with your bit. Turn out to 90 and the drill cuts sideways along it.
There is a vein at your depth. Steer all the way over to 90 and follow it across.
Ore off your line and in reach. G sends a crew member to dig it by hand. The drill parks itself, so leave the power alone.
That ore is within a walk. Press G, then click the rock. The drill stops on its own while they are out.
Rich rock inside charge range. F2, then click it: a charge cracks it open and half the ore survives. Half is still half.
Charges in stock and good rock in range. F2 arms the launcher. Click the target and keep your head down.
Fault rock ahead. Press W for bracing: a layer soaks a rockfall. The rock down here does fall.
That hatching on the scanner is fault rock. Power bracing with W before you cut into it.
Fire aboard. Press F to douse the worst one. It costs one coolant a press, and the nozzle needs 6 seconds to vent again.
Burning, Auger. F puts out the worst fire for one coolant. Wait the 6 seconds before the next press.
The bit has broken. Press B to fit a spare. The drill crawls until you do.
Bit failure. B fits a spare from stores. We did warn them about the supplier.
Nobody is heading for that trouble. Press 1, 2 or 3 to pick a crew member, then click the room to send them.
Unattended damage aboard. Pick a crew member with 1 to 3 and click the room. They go where they are told.
Hostile contact. F1 and F2 arm a weapon. Click an enemy room to fire.
Arm a weapon with F1 or F2, then pick a room on their rig. Power the guns first.
You have research banked. Press R for requisitions: research buys starting gear for the next descent. It does not keep.
Unspent research on file. R opens requisitions, where it becomes starting gear. Spend it.
That is the survey chart. The marks beside each node show what is in the rock on the way. Read them before you choose.
Survey marks, Auger. They list what the rock holds along each route. Pick a route on purpose.
Space pauses the dive. You may still give orders while paused. They land when time resumes.
Press Space to stop the clock. Orders given while paused go out the moment you resume.
There is a structure ahead that is not on the survey. Cut into it with the drill or a blast: crates pay at once. G sends the miner to any crate in range.
Buried construction, close. Break in with the drill or a charge and the crates pay out at once. G sends the miner to a crate in reach.
